The '''Denon-Ardru Mutual''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and refinery corporation active during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
Based on the [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] and [[Ardru]], the Denon-Ardru Mutual was present on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] like [[Ord Sigatt]].

Although the influx of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that were brought to worlds were welcomed by the natives, many beings complained that Denon-Ardru Mutual would soon bring in their own security forces to protect their investments. These security forces were often ruthless in their attempts to defend the mines, and many worlds experienced small rebellions as the natives tried to fight back against corporate oppression. These rebellions were eventually put down when Denon-Ardru Mutual found ways to take over the local governments, implementing new laws that allowed them to confiscate weapons and steal land from colonists.

==History==
The operations of Denon-Ardru Mutual were exposed by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], about eleven years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], during their search for the missing refinery vessel ''[[Hardy Harrow]]''. A [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from Denon had reported the ship missing, fearing that the crew had been captured or killed by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] discovered that the ship carried the corporation's personnel on Ord Sigatt arrested and sent back to Denon in the ship.

Further investigation revealed that the senator who had made the initial report had provided a large percentage of the finances used to establish the operations on Ord Sigatt.
